# Shubham Bhatt (@BhattBuilds)

> Shubham Bhatt is an indie founder and software engineer from Uttarakhand, India. He goes by @BhattBuilds online. He builds IdeaFast, a tool that finds real customer pain on Reddit, and he freelances: he builds software for clients (MVPs, automations, dashboards and more) and works in AI training. He has made $10K+ freelancing. This is his official website: https://shubhambhatt.me

## Who he is

- Name: Shubham Bhatt
- Handle: @BhattBuilds (X, Instagram, Threads, TrustMRR)
- Location: Uttarakhand, India
- Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science Engineering (2021 to 2025)
- In 2025, he chose to build his own business instead of taking a job.
- Competitive programmer: 1000+ LeetCode problems solved, LeetCode Knight.
- Former SDE intern at Bluestock Fintech, where he led a team of 6.
- Part-time technical writer at [LearnYard](https://learnyard.com/) (November 2024 to April 2025): wrote 100+ DSA solution articles.

## What he builds

- [IdeaFast](https://www.ideafast.pro/): reads Reddit communities, groups complaints into pain themes, scores each one from 0 to 100, and links every theme to the original posts. Founded April 2026. Listed on GummySearch's alternatives page. About 470 users. First scan free, then $19 one-time.
- IdeaFast revenue is verified on TrustMRR through Dodo Payments: $413 all-time as of November 23, 2026. Source: https://trustmrr.com/startup/ideafast
- Pulse: his own analytics dashboard built on PostHog and payment data.
- Dictately: a free, offline voice typing app for Mac. Press a hotkey, speak, and the text appears where the cursor is. Built in Swift, runs Whisper locally with Apple Silicon GPU acceleration.

## Freelance work

He has made $10K+ freelancing. Client names are kept private.

- AI training (since August 2026, ongoing): freelance work helping train AI models. He reviews and grades the data AI models learn from and checks submitted work for quality. Moved up to a higher reviewer tier after hitting quality and speed targets.
- AI claims platform (August 2025): a production-ready MVP for a US startup, for incident management and claims processing. Built with FastAPI, Next.js, Postgres, OpenAI and AWS S3. A $4.3K project. He found the client on X.
- Game studio automation (April 2026): an n8n automation for a game development studio. A paid project (about $100, ₹8,000).
